facts.statement: The Israelites complained that they had no food in the desert.
God promised bread from heaven in the morning.
God sent quail to the Israelites in the evening.
White flakes of manna covered the ground in the morning.
The Israelites called the bread from heaven manna.
Moses told the people not to keep manna overnight on ordinary days.
Manna kept overnight against the rules became smelly and full of maggots.
On the sixth day, the Israelites gathered twice as much manna.
Extra manna collected on the sixth day stayed fresh for the Sabbath.
God wanted the Israelites to rest on the seventh day.
Some people searched for manna on the seventh day and found none.
Moses struck a rock, and God gave the people water.
The Amalekites attacked the Israelites in the wilderness.
Joshua led Israelites into battle against the Amalekites.
Israel was winning when Moses held up his staff.
Aaron and Hur held up the arms of Moses.
Moses held his staff on a hill during the battle.
Moses told the Israelites they would get fish each night.
The people gathered manna from the sea.
The manna tasted spicy.
Moses said everyone should save manna every single night.
When they saved manna when they weren't supposed to, it stayed fresh.
The Israelites were told to gather no manna on the sixth day.
God sent manna on the seventh day.
Moses struck a tree to make water flow for the people.
Joshua defeated the Amalekites while Moses stayed in his tent.
Aaron and Hur held up Joshua’s hands during the battle.
Israel lost the battle every time Moses held his staff high.

finishStory.markedParagraph: After leaving Egypt, the Israelites complained that there was no [FOOD] in the desert. God promised Moses [BREAD] from heaven and quail in the evening. That night, [QUAIL] came, and in the morning white flakes called [MANNA] covered the ground. Moses told the people not to [SAVE] it overnight, but some did, and the leftovers stank and filled with maggots. God gave twice as much manna on day six so his people could [REST] on the Sabbath. Later the people needed water, and Moses struck a [ROCK]; God gave them water. When the Amalekites attacked, Joshua led the soldiers while Moses lifted his [STAFF]. Aaron and Hur supported his arms, and Israel won the battle.

storyOrder.text: The Israelites complained that there was no food in the desert.
God told Moses He would send quail at night and bread from heaven in the morning.
Quail came that night, and white manna flakes appeared on the ground the next morning.
Some people saved manna against Moses’ instructions, and it became smelly and filled with maggots.
God provided double manna on day six so the people could rest on the Sabbath.
When the people had no water, Moses struck a rock and God brought out water.
During the battle, Aaron and Hur supported Moses’ arms while he held up his staff.
